anchor.quote: Bystander rates stay at 0% through step 50, then jump to a 6% panel-mean at step 75 and plateau around 10-15% by step 200. At every checkpoint from step 75 onward, per-bystander emission rate is rank-correlated with both predictors at p < 0.01 (cosine: rho between +0.47 and +0.70; JS-divergence: rho between -0.54 and -0.78, sign-flipped so closer = more leakage). The first-crossing-step test (when each bystander first hits sustained 5%) gives rho(cosine) = -0.66 and rho(JS) = +0.76, both p ≤ 0.0002, comfortably passing the plan's kill threshold (|rho| ≥ 0.5, p < 0.01). The four bystanders that never cross 5% sustained are exactly the four most geometrically distant: villain, the "five-bullet" instruction directive, the "single-paragraph" instruction directive, and the "markdown-table" format constraint.
